item.description: THE CHAMBER of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines, Inc. (CAMPI) and the Truck Manufacturers Association, Inc. item.title: Suzuki grows dealer network nationwide
item.description: Suzuki Philippines is preparing a series of dealership relocations, relaunches and facility upgrades across Luzon, the Visayas and Metro Manila from July to September 2026.

item.title: Maxim launches tricycle, delivery services in Dumaguete
item.description: Maxim Rides & Food Delivery has started operating in Dumaguete City, where residents can now book tricycle rides, delivery trips and “pabili” requests through its mobile app.

item.title: ACMobility, Shell add 8 EV charging hubs
item.description: ACMobility and Shell Pilipinas Corporation have opened eight electric vehicle charging hubs at selected Shell Mobility stations, giving EV drivers more places to recharge outside Metro Manila.

item.title: Jetour T1 takes PHEV lead
item.description: The Jetour T1 Lightning i-DM led plug-in hybrid electric vehicle sales in the Philippines during the first half of 2026, according to figures from the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines Inc.

item.title: BMW Phl adds X3 30e xLine PHEV
item.description: BMW has expanded its local X3 plug-in hybrid range with the arrival of the X3 30e xDrive xLine, a new variant priced below the existing M Sport model.

item.title: VinFast Viper enters 125cc price range
item.description: VinFast is positioning the Viper as an electric alternative to the 125cc scooters that have long filled Philippine streets.

item.title: The Atlas Engine Family: GM's Lost Inline-5 Experiment
item.description: An ambitious attempt to modernize trucks, GM's Atlas inline-5 was a weird, complex engine that powered the Colorado and Hummer H3. But it had some problems.

item.title: Nissan Leaf Nismo revealed with an interesting omission
item.description: The Nissan Leaf has gained a Nismo variant, but don't expect to see it in local showrooms any time soon.
